{{Quote|People of the galaxy, welcome to Carannia. Here you will discover all the Outer Rim has to offer. Innovation. Exploration. A brave frontier awaits, worlds of opportunity and adventure, all accessible by safe and reliable hyperroutes...|Hologram announcer|<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />}}
'''Carannia''' was the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[planet]] [[Serenno]]. It shared its name with [[Carannian fur]] which was worn by [[Serennian]] [[Senator]] [[Izzet Noor]] during the [[High Republic Era|High Republic]]. During the last [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], the city adopted the same anti-Republic stance as [[Fiyaro]] and [[Saffia]]. By the end of the High Republic era, [[Jedi Initiate]]s [[Dooku]] and [[Sifo-Dyas]] visited the city during a [[Celebration on Serenno|festival]] that saw the city booming with visitors. In the late [[Republic Era|Republic era]], the city was invaded by [[Abyssin]] [[Mercenary|Mercenaries]] hired by [[Count]] [[Ramil]] leading to much of the city being destroyed. This caused Dooku to replace Ramil as [[Count of Serenno]]. By [[23 BBY]], much of the city was rebuilt under Count Dooku using the profits gained from processing a seam of [[sacanium]] near the city. Dooku's reign however saw unemployment in the city spike with workers being replaced in favor of [[droid]]s. In 23 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], [[Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]] was tasked with finding [[Jenza]], Dooku's sister in the city where she found and [[Death|killed]] Jenza under orders from Dooku. During the [[Clone Wars]], former Sith assassin Ventress and a group of [[Bounty hunter]]s landed at the local [[spaceport]] in the city. In the [[Imperial Era|Imperial era]], [[Corellian]] [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] landed at the same spaceport sometime before [[1 BBY]].

==Description==
The city was located along the shoreline of the [[Belsallian Sea]],<ref name="BMF 70" /> near the [[Carannian hills]].<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" /> The city consisted of vaulted structures and cylindrical [[tower]]s that extended to the [[forest]]-covered hills of the [[mountain]] range nearby.<ref name="Scarif and Other">{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}}</ref> Much of the grand architecture in the city complemented the natural surroundings of Serenno's flora. The city contained the [[Carannia Spaceport]] which was also known as the Serenno [[spaceport]] that housed many [[:Category:Starship classes|starship classes]] such as [[:Category:Bulk cruisers|bulk cruisers]] with its design being sympathetic to its natural surroundings.<ref name="BMF 70" /> The city also contained various government facilities such as the [[Great Assembly House]], an enormous cathedral with a large domed ceiling which housed the Planetary [[Great Houses|council]] of Serenno.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" /> By [[23 BBY]],<ref name="Date Note">Senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] states that she spent a year prior to outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]] trying to defeat the Military Creation Act. As ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the outbreak of the Clone Wars as occurring in [[22 BBY]], the Military Creation Act must have been proposed by [[23 BBY]].</ref> close to the Carannia spaceport was the [[Trannon district]] where the [[Portmaster's office]] was situated which controlled space travel to and from the local spaceport. The [[Belsallian Cantina]], a spaceport [[cantina]], was constructed by this time. Many warehouses were also situated inside the city with one notable warehouse being close to the cargo stores that were near a crumbling res block.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

==History==
===High Republic Era===
In [[90 BBY]],<ref name="Date">According to ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]'', [[Dooku]] was eighty [[Standard year|years]] old at the time of the [[First Battle of Geonosis]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the Battle of Geonosis in [[22 BBY]], placing Dooku's birth year in [[102 BBY]]. The [[Dooku: Jedi Lost (script)|script]] of ''[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]'' states that Dooku was twelve years old at the time of the celebration, placing the celebration around [[90 BBY]].</ref> a [[Celebration on Serenno|grand celebration]] took place in the city leading to many visitors coming to see the city and the festival which included [[Jedi Initiate]]s Dooku and Sifo- Dyas. While Dooku and Sifo Dyas were talking and exploring the city, Dooku noticed [[Jenza]] in the crowd after running off from her [[droid]] caretaker [[D-4]]. Sensing that he knew her somehow, Dooku followed Jenza. Making sure that Dooku didn't get in trouble, Sifo Dyas followed him. While Dooku followed Jenza, Jenza was robbed by a [[Bry|thief]]. Determined to get back her purse and a crystal belonging to her grandmother, Jenza confronted the thief. This led to the thief and his allies to harass Jenza and later [[Ramil]]. Before any further escalation could occur, Dooku intervened and fought the thief and his friends. After Dooku fought and won the fight, Jenza gave Dooku a tour of the city including the Great Assembly House. While exploring the Great Assembly House, a carving of the [[Tirra'Taka]] drew Dooku's attention. When Dooku touched the carving, a sudden [[groundquake]] caused the structure to collapse. This led to the [[Jedi Master]]s and [[rescue droid]]s rescuing the two children from the rubble. Right after the two children were rescued, Count [[Gora]] was angry with [[Grand Master]] [[Yoda]] of bringing his [[Force-sensitive]] son, Dooku to Serenno. After ordering the [[Jedi]] to leave, Dooku and the Jedi Masters left the city and the planet.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

===Late Republic Era===
====Prelude and invasion====
When Ramil became Count of Serenno, he allowed pirates to raid Serenno leading to the Great Houses hiring [[Abyssin]] [[Mercenary|mercenaries]]. The mercenaries were bought out by Ramil who organised the [[Incident on Serenno|Invasion of Serenno]] with the mercenaries taking control of Serenno and the city which led to much of the city being destroyed. Outnumbered by the mercenaries and receiving no help from Ramil, Jenza, acting on behalf of the [[Serennian Resistance|resistance group]] fighting the mercenaries, requested Jedi Master Dooku for help. After failing to convince the [[Jedi Council]] to help the planet because Ramil refused to pay taxes to the Republic, Jedi Masters Dooku, Sifo- Dyas and [[Lene Kostana]] travelled to the planet in the [[Truthseeker]] where they were fired upon by the mercenaries. After crash- landing in the [[Delgaldon Plains]] and meeting up with the resistance group, Dooku led the assault on a nearby [[Abyssin Outpost|outpost]] close to the city and took over the outpost. Immediately after Dooku and the Serennian resistance group took over the outpost, Ramil and his [[Ramil's droid army|droid army]] intervened and ordered Dooku, Sifo Dyas, Kostana and the rest of the resistance group to surrender. After surrendering, Dooku was summoned to the ''[[Windrunner]]'', Ramil's airship, where Ramil mocked and [[torture]]d Dooku of how he will sort Serenno by removing the [[Great Houses]] governing the planet thereby removing the infighting that led to multiple crises on the planet. When Ramil ordered Jenza killed by [[Dooku's lightsaber|his own lightsaber]], Dooku was consumed by anger and controlled the Tirra'Taka, an ancient [[Reptile|reptilian]] dragon, which ravaged Ramil's droid army below. Dooku then took an [[electrostaff]] and destroyed the [[central processor]] controlling Ramil's droid army. He later killed Ramil using his own lightsaber and was forced to kill the Tirra'Taka after he lost control of the creature. After the battle, a seam of [[sacanium]] near Carannia was discovered which was used to help rebuild the city. By 23 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]], much of the city was rebuilt under the newly appointed Count Dooku.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

====Later history====
Although much of the city was rebuilt, Dooku like his predecessors, replaced workers with droids causing unemployment to skyrocket. In 23 BBY, under orders from Count Dooku, [[Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]] went to the city to find Jenza who had been kidnapped there. After Ventress barged into the Portmasters office located in the Trannon District, she found out that Jenza was kidnapped by [[Glute]], a [[Crolute]] criminal. She later went to the Belsallian Cantina and tortured members of the [[Razorclaw Gang]] to find where Glute was hiding. When Ventress found Glute in a crumbling res block near a warehouse, she confronted Glute. Before she could interrogate the criminal, Glute was shot by [[Republic Intelligence]] officer [[Raz Fellidrone]] who Ventress tracked to his own [[Fellidrone's Apartment|apartment]]. After following the officer to his apartment, Ventress managed to find and free Jenza in a secret compartment located in the portmasters apartment. Dooku later arrived and ordered Ventress to kill Jenza and bury the evidence. Ventress obliged and assassinated Jenza then caused a fire that destroyed the apartment and the building where the apartment was located.<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" />

===Clone Wars and Imperial Era===
Towards the end of the [[Clone Wars]], in an attempt to [[Mission to Serenno (Krayt's Claw)|rescue]] Jedi Master [[Quinlan Vos]], former Sith assassin Ventress and a syndicate called [[Krayt's Claw]] led by [[Boba Fett]] landed at the local Carannia Spaceport in the ''[[Slave I]]''. After landing at the spaceport, the group travelled to [[Castle Serenno]], the home of Count Dooku, where Vos was held at.<ref name="Dark Disciple">''[[Dark Disciple]]''</ref> At some time in the [[Imperial Era|Imperial era]],<ref name="PSFB">''[[A New Hope: The Princess, the Scoundrel, and the Farm Boy]]''</ref> prior to [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date2">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IV}}, which this novel adapts, in [[1 BBY]]–[[0 ABY]].</ref> [[Corellian]] [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] met a girl named [[Sarla]] at the Carannia Spaceport in the city where he flirted with her.<ref name="PSFB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Carannia was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 70]] magazine published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="BMF 70" /> and released on [[May 4]], [[2016]].<ref name="BMFdate">{{BuildFalconDates|70}}</ref> It later appeared in the [[Dooku: Jedi Lost (script)|script book version]] of the [[canon]] audiobook, "[[Dooku: Jedi Lost]]" written by [[Cavan Scott]]<ref name="Dooku: Jedi Lost" /> and released on [[April 30]], [[2019]].<ref name="Penguin-Download">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/607498/dooku-jedi-lost-star-wars-by-cavan-scott/9780593102817|text=Dooku: Jedi Lost (Star Wars)}}</ref> In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], the location first appeared in the [[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]] novel.<ref name="DB:ROT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> The city was later pictured in the [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|sixth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Agent of the Empire]]'' comic series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]].<ref name="AotE - HT1">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]]</ref>
